quick_learn.title: Bhagavad Gita — Action & Equanimity
quick_learn.explanation: Gita → action + equanimity KEY RELATIONSHIPS • Karma Yoga • Equanimity toward outcomes • Self-knowledge • Discipline of action • DISTINCTION / CAUTION • Do not reduce it to a single religious slogan.
